metadata.description: The sharaqi workflow for Claude Code: a cost-aware router. Opus routes, the cheapest capable model and effort implements, review scales with risk, and a receipt for the tokens spent.

plugins.name: sharaqi
plugins.description: /sharaqi do <task>: Opus makes one cheap routing decision (plan or not, which model and effort implements, how much review), delegates to the cheapest capable rung under a hook-enforced model and effort ceiling, re-runs the checks, and reports only what it verified, with a token receipt. /sharaqi route <task> shows the decision without running it.
